NIT Rourkela Develops Advanced Composite, Secures Patent

The National Institute of Technology (NIT) Rourkela has developed an advanced 3D-reinforced composite material. This innovation is designed for applications in the aerospace and automotive sectors. The institute has also secured a patent for this new composite technology. The development aims to enhance performance and durability in these demanding industries.
